to_lines: M/s MURUGAN CABLE NETWORKS PRIVATE LIMITED
subject: GST — Verification of Input Tax Credit — ITC availed on invoices of suo-moto cancelled suppliers — Call for documents – Regarding.

letter_body.text: It is informed that, on verification of the returns filed by you, input tax credit appears to have been availed on invoices issued by suppliers whose registrations stand cancelled suo-moto. (Demo example - fictional data.)

In order to verify the eligibility of the said credit under Section 16(2) of the CGST Act, 2017, you are requested to produce copies of the following documents for the period **__Financial Year 2024-25__** within seven (7) days of receipt of this letter:
Purchase invoices of the suppliers listed in the Annexure.
Proof of payment to the suppliers (bank statements).
Proof of receipt of goods / services (delivery challans, e-way bills).
Failure to furnish the documents within the time allowed may result in action as per the provisions of the CGST Act, 2017.

notesheet_subject: Verification of ITC – M/s MURUGAN CABLE NETWORKS PRIVATE LIMITED, GSTIN: 33AAKCM4417R1ZZ – ITC from suo-moto cancelled suppliers – reg.

notesheet_body.text: M/s Murugan Cable Networks Private Limited (GSTIN: 33AAKCM4417R1ZZ) is a regular taxpayer engaged in broadcast distribution services (SAC 998465). (Demo example - fictional data.)

Comparison of GSTR-2B with GSTR-3B for FY 2024-25 shows ITC of ₹18,80,000/- (Rupees Eighteen Lakh Eighty Thousand only) availed on invoices of three suppliers whose registrations were cancelled suo-moto.
It is therefore proposed to call for the following documents from the taxpayer:
Purchase invoices of the said suppliers.
Proof of payment and receipt of goods / services.
Submitted for perusal and approval of the competent authority.
